work_packages.title: Native boundary and feasibility proof
work_packages.deliverable: Versioned package/handoff contract, stack feasibility and attestation/distribution proof
work_packages.gate: D-36/D-37 unresolved values remain parameters; no acceptance bypass

work_packages.title: Thin shell and device-bound session
work_packages.deliverable: Narrow native shell, secure handoff, registration/revocation and keystore integration
work_packages.gate: No copied web session, embedded credential or native role client

work_packages.title: Protected camera and provenance
work_packages.deliverable: Camera-only capture and content-bound location/time/integrity envelope with server verification
work_packages.gate: Unsupported integrity or stale/mismatched evidence is not trusted

work_packages.title: Offline custody and revocation
work_packages.deliverable: Encrypted bounded package, process recovery, key loss/expiry/revocation and crypto-shredding
work_packages.gate: No claim of immediate wipe while offline or absolute offline time

work_packages.title: Native upload and web handoff
work_packages.deliverable: Resumable native queue, idempotent commit and web status/recovery integration
work_packages.gate: Only an acknowledged core commit completes ingestion; no client seal or financial decision

work_packages.title: Platform hardening and independent evidence
work_packages.deliverable: Both-platform negative tests, device matrix, full source/coverage gates and exact-SHA review pack
work_packages.gate: Physical-device and independent-test evidence cannot be replaced by simulated runs

device_runs.note: Automatic probes measured on the device and accepted. G3.4, G4.5 and G3.5 were recorded with the harness's Mark pass button without the measured action and are not accepted; they remain PENDING. G6.3 FAIL is mode-limited (no Notification API in an iOS tab) and is measurable only in installed mode. See runs/2026-09-23-iphone16promax-safari-tab.review.md.

provider_tracks.name: Identity / KYC
requested_inputs: Authoritative identity fields, match outcomes, expiry and reverification
Sandbox terms, service account ownership and permitted synthetic identities
exit_evidence: Selected provider/contract with allowed fields and privacy review
Sandbox outcome evidence and approved KYC decision mapping

provider_tracks.name: Business registry / KYB
requested_inputs: Registration/ownership/mandate response schema and authoritative refresh source
A response sample with prohibited tax identifiers removed
exit_evidence: Approved ownership/mandate contract and redaction tests
Evidence that raw/logged/derived data do not retain prohibited TIN/tax fields

provider_tracks.name: Sanctions / PEP / AML
requested_inputs: Screening sources, matching thresholds, refresh/escalation and case ownership
Approved restrictions and release authority; no automatic unapproved penalties
exit_evidence: Approved screening and monitoring policy plus case/appeal mapping
Certified test cases and audited restrictions/release evidence

provider_tracks.name: ICPAR / Audit Partner verification
requested_inputs: API, signed file or governed manual route; authoritative ID/certificate/standing fields
Refresh SLA, suspension and false-match escalation contact
exit_evidence: ICPAR-authorized source/route and refresh contract
Accreditation/dispatch denial tests; retained professional approval evidence

provider_tracks.name: Statement parsing / OCR
requested_inputs: Authorized bank/MoMo statement corpus, parser formats and processing location
Confidence/correction lineage and rejection taxonomy; no new evidence types
exit_evidence: Versioned provider/parser contract and licensed synthetic/redacted corpus
Source hash to normalized/corrected value lineage and no unapproved underwriting activation

provider_tracks.name: Bank / custody / reconciliation
requested_inputs: Custody account topology, ownership, permitted rails and settlement identifiers
Cutoffs, reversals, reconciliation files and authorization requirements
exit_evidence: Signed custody and rail contracts; separated credentials/accounts
Provider-certified settlement/reversal/reconciliation evidence; lawful live go/no-go

provider_tracks.name: MoMo / both required networks
requested_inputs: Separate coverage/contract and sandbox route for each required network
Collection/disbursement/funding/withdrawal statuses, signatures, limits and cutoffs
exit_evidence: A certification record for each network and each enabled operation
Exactly-once callback/reversal and reconciled external transaction evidence; no promised same-day SLA without contract

provider_tracks.name: Messaging / SMS / email / push
requested_inputs: Required/optional notices, consent, language, quiet hours and approved templates
Delivery callbacks, sender/account ownership, expiry and fallback rules
exit_evidence: Approved communication rules/templates and selected sender providers
Delivery/fallback/consent evidence with redacted logs; no real messages from demo/UAT

provider_tracks.name: Storage / backup / key custody
requested_inputs: Data classes, region/residency, retention/legal holds and recovery objectives
Per-environment accounts/buckets/keys, immutable evidence and key recovery/revocation
exit_evidence: Approved residency/retention and dedicated least-privilege resources
Negative cross-environment access, backup/restore, key rotation/revocation and retention evidence

provider_tracks.name: Maps / geocoding
requested_inputs: Registered-office/premises coordinate authority and permitted geocoder terms
Accuracy/boundary/refresh policy; separate live device observations
exit_evidence: Approved coordinate and distance contract with synthetic boundary fixtures
Dispatch uses registered coordinates; no geocoder result treated as attested physical presence

provider_tracks.name: External legal / contractual clearance
requested_inputs: Named external counsel, engagement scope and required clearance artifacts
Note/custody/secondary/disclosure/complaints/privacy/AUP document set
exit_evidence: Counsel-issued written disposition for the exact product/contract versions
Internal owner approvals remain separate from external legal authority

provider_tracks.name: CMA / sandbox / supervisory reporting
requested_inputs: Named supervisory contact/route, application requirements and sandbox conditions
Return schemas/frequency/channel, acknowledgements/corrections and supervisor visibility
exit_evidence: Written authorization/conditions for the exact pilot scope before real-money operations
Regulator-approved return/acknowledgement evidence and scoped read-only supervisor controls

provider_tracks.name: Native integrity / signing / distribution
requested_inputs: Organization-owned Apple/Google accounts, app identifiers and approved distribution route
Supported OS/device and integrity-verdict policy, signing custody and revocation owner
exit_evidence: Actual signed builds on the approved device matrix with server-verified assertions
Chosen distribution works with attestation; key/credential custody and loss/revocation evidence
